patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Linear and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Linear only if your buying job matches “Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo ” rather than Motion's shape. Choose Motion only if your buying job matches “AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo an” rather than Linear's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Linear is shaped for Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Bas whereas Motion is shaped for AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Linear and Motion share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Linear is Modern issue tracker for product/engineering teams — Free limited; Basic from ~$8/user/mo annual.; Motion is AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/seat/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Linear (startup, small-business, mid-market) vs Motion (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: Linear — Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Motion — Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors.

Limitations — Linear: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS; Leaner automation than Jira Enterprise; Motion: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors; AI credit caps and top-ups affect TCO.

Poor-fit cases: Linear is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not for company-wide marketing/ops Work OS · Motion is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Premium $19+ seats vs broader Work OS floors · Avoid Linear if you actually need Motion's motion (AI calendar + task auto-scheduling (projects, docs, meetings) — Pro AI from $19/)
